body:
I realized that the [docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/shaders/shader_reference/shading_language.html#Comments) were lying about the _Inspector_ stripping the asterisks at the beginning of each doc comment line, it was actually the Regex doing so, so I have to implement that myself. :D I tried to fix it, however, it seems like the check doesn't work (perhaps due to the character check from `comment_chars` not working).

Also, the previous behavior was to only add the documentation if it immediately preceded the uniform, but here, it adds it even if there's unrelated code in the way. I tried to fix it by clearing `comment_chars`, but it seems like it doesn't work, either.

If anyone knows how to fix these, please suggest so.

Edit: I forgot that I was testing the wrong build. My brain never works lol. Please ignore this. Everything should work properly now.
